entities.name: Karumonix
entities.description: A Phyrexian rat hivemind on New Phyrexia formed when countless rats consumed one another and fused into a collective consciousness.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane that Mirrodin became, home of Karumonix.

entities.name: Mirran-Phyrexian War
entities.description: War after which the rat population on Mirrodin swelled further.

events.summary: Rats on Mirrodin consume one another and fuse into a single collective consciousness that names itself Karumonix.
events.quote: The bones, flesh, and piercing cries of countless rats fused into a collective consciousness that named itself Karumonix.
